priorityList: Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target from you or another Hunter in the group!
Pre-cast Aimed Shot around 2.5 seconds before combat begins.
Continue your normal rotation. Cast Moonlight Chakram once you dip below 35 Focus, or 1.2 Aimed Shot charges.
Trinket Usage We generally want to use stat-granting on-use trinkets with Trueshot.
Cast Rapid Fire if you do not have the Bulletstorm buff active.

Cast Volley on cooldown. On single-target, its only role is doing a bit of damage for us, and activating Double Tap. Never cast Volley right before or after Trueshot, as that would waste the Double Tap generated by either.

Cast Moonlight Chakram when you have fewer than 1.2 charges of Aimed Shot remaining, or if you have less than 35 Focus. The practical goal is to not let its use interfere with maximizing our Aimed Shot casts. Using it a bit late in Trueshot is fine.
Cast Steady Shot as a filler. Do not neglect the importance of filling every "empty" moment with these, as they generate a lot of Focus and Aimed Shot cooldown reduction.
Continue your normal rotation, spending Black Arrow procs as you get them.
Cast Black Arrow whenever available. Since Rapid Fire guarantees a proc, anticipate casting Black Arrow immediately after every Rapid Fire.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Bulletstorm buff would expire before you could finish an Aimed Shot cast.

Activate Trueshot.Trueshot grants an instant Black Arrow proc, use this immediately. Avoid casting Trueshot and Volley back-to-back to prevent overwriting Double Tap. Always weave an ability like Aimed Shot between them.
Cast Wailing Arrow. This ability replaces Trueshot after you activate it, and can be used once. Treat it as a filler, and always follow it up with Black Arrow

Cast Multi-Shot to spend the Precise Shots stacks generated by Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire, and to activate Trick Shots. As a rule of thumb, always cast Multi-Shot immediately after every Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire.

Cast Volley on cooldown. Its only role is doing a bit of damage for us, and activating Double Tap. Never cast Volley right before or after Trueshot, as that would waste the Double Tap generated by either.
Cast Multi-Shot to consume Precise Shots stacks from Aimed Shot and Rapid Fire. Generally, you should follow every Aimed Shot or Rapid Fire with Multi-Shot.
Ensure Hunter's Mark is active on the highest-health target from you or another Hunter in the group!
On single-target only, pre-cast Aimed Shot around 2.5 seconds before combat begins. Do not bother with this on 3+ targets.
